text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 105 vials of doxorubicin hydrochloride 2 mg/mL 10 mL (33.1 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 65 vials (23.2 days on hand). The labeler and manufacturer is Pfizer Laboratories Div Pfizer Inc.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include doxorubicin hydrochloride as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory provides adequate supply at both campuses. No shortage exists per FDA records. Proactive sourcing from alternate manufacturers is warranted to maintain supply continuity given single-source reliance on Pfizer.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to evaluate Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC (Amneal Oncology Pvt. Ltd., Telangana 509301) for contract addition; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
2. Buyer to evaluate Baxter Healthcare Corporation (Eurofins Biolab Srl, last inspection VAI 2024-09-13) for contract addition; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
3. Buyer to evaluate Gland Pharma Limited (last inspection NAI 2023-07-28) for contract addition; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
4. Buyer to evaluate Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (THYMOORGAN PHARMAZIE GmbH) for contract addition; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.
5. Buyer to evaluate Sagent Pharmaceuticals (QILU PHARM HAINAN) for contract addition; requires P&T committee approval for formulary addition.

Not recommended: Emergency purchasing or allocation restrictions at this time.
